query: What sanctions could street peddlers expect if they're constantly bothered?
reference_answer:
Harassment of Street Vendors:
Punishment can include imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine up to ₹5,000 under the Tamil Nadu Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Rules.
answer: Street peddlers expecting constant bother might face fines, license suspensions, or even bans from certain areas, depending on local regulations and enforcement. [System]
